sources.scope: Provider status only. Study.com and University Pathways International are approved. CLEP and Sophia are provisionally approved with review pending. Neither heading establishes a particular receiving-course award or individual enrollment permission.

General transfer guidance does not create an exact university-course equivalency or establish placement in an individual degree. Institutional-origin credit remains distinct from ACE/NCCRS recommendations and from TESU residency.

findings.detail: The policy-versus-provider-directory question from the November 19 audit remains unresolved at the course level. A source-bound specific course resolution could be evaluated after recovery of an active university table; no global provider hold is removed from a cached search result.

A College Board C-level score recommendation is not a university-published numeric minimum. A receiving-table expiration is not an ACE recommendation start or version. Multi-course awards require proper bundle allocation rather than duplicate original courses.

45 source-bound placements reuse the existing reviewed discipline and receiving-level rules. A scoped fresh solver comparison expands the feasible conditional outside basket from 75 to 84 credits while preserving academic counts and policy completeness. It does not close university receiving-award research.

Current official degree captures and named major-course/prerequisite facts were retained for Marketing, Human Resources/Organizational Management and Operations Management. They were not compiled into additional unready public program shells. The Operations OPM-4110 prerequisite discrepancy remains explicit.
